Straight from the New York Times , Team:
" President Trump on [March 31] stepped up efforts to promote his false claims of widespread voting fraud, signing an executive order of questionable constitutionality seeking to create a national list of citizens that would determine voting eligibility and restrict mail ballots. "
Let's be clear: The president has no explicit Constitutional authority over elections, and much of this latest attack on our fundamental right to vote appears difficult to enforce and legally dubious.
This order directs the Department of Homeland Security to create a “ state citizenship list ” based on data from various federal databases. It also directs federal officials to send that made-up list to state election officials, and orders the attorney general to prioritize prosecution of election officials who provide ballots to voters not on the made-up list. It also directs the U.S. Postal Service not to transmit mail-in ballots from any individual not included on Trump's “ state citizenship list ," even though elections are mandated by the constitutional the be run by the states.
This order is yet another sign that the MAGA crew will do anything they can to codify their power permanently and silence the will of the people by suppressing and eliminating the votes we cast.

subject: Who do YOU want to run for President?
body:

Derek, **We’re just _83 days_ away from Election Day. But once the midterms end, Democrats _need_ to be prepared to hit the ground running ahead of 2028.** The work we do now — _every door we knock, every call we make, every dollar we raise_ — works not only toward winning this year, but towards building the long-term infrastructure Democrats need to win back the White House in 2028. So, as we sprint across the finish line this November and get ready for the marathon ahead, we want to hear from our most engaged grassroots supporters: [**Who do _you_ want to see on the 2028 ticket?**](https://ak.democrats.org/signup/20260812_2028_survey/?refcode=em_20260812_8531_fr&amount=7&akid=8531%2E22930333%2EOIsa00) **[SHARE YOUR THOUGHTS](https://ak.democrats.org/signup/20260812_2028_survey/?refcode=em_20260812_8531_fr&akid=8531%2E22930333%2EOIsa00)** Thank you, The Democrats

_If you gave recently via check or mail, our system may not have yet processed your gift. We are appreciative and thank you greatly for your support._

name: R. Cooper
subject: This isn’t an email asking for money
body:
I need people like you with me in this fight, Peter.
|
# [](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_su_pros_jtk1012&source=&t=1&akid=2706%2E124072%2EEa81G1)
| | | |
---
Peter, I’m not here to ask for money.
I’m just asking you to endorse my campaign for U.S. Senate in North Carolina. I’m looking for 30,000 signatures, and I’m counting on yours to be one of them. [**_Will you take 30 seconds to add your name?_**](https://act.roycooper.com/survey/endorse-cooper-260812-email-nd/?source=email_su_pros_jtk1012&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=&ask=5&askdif=25&t=8&akid=2706%2E124072%2EEa81G1)
| | [ADD YOUR NAME](https://act.roycooper.com/survey/endorse-cooper-260812-email-nd/?source=email_su_pros_jtk1012&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=&ask=5&askdif=25&t=9&akid=2706%2E124072%2EEa81G1)
---
I have spent my life trying to do right by the people of North Carolina.
Whether as a state legislator or Attorney General or Governor, I’ve fought hard to protect our fundamental rights, expand health care and put working families first.
I’m running to take this critical work to Washington DC – but right now, the GOP is firing on all cylinders to defeat me. Super PACs are pouring millions into attack ads smearing my name, and President Trump is all in to support my opponent, former Big Oil and utility company lobbyist Michael Whatley.
I know we can defeat Whatley and flip this seat, but I can’t do it alone. I need people like you with me in this fight, Peter.
[**_So if you’re ready to win in North Carolina, take back the Senate and prevent two more years of unchecked Republican rule, will you endorse my grassroots Senate campaign today?**_](https://act.roycooper.com/survey/endorse-cooper-260812-email-nd/?source=email_su_pros_jtk1012&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=&ask=5&askdif=25&t=10&akid=2706%2E124072%2EEa81G1)
| | [ADD YOUR NAME](https://act.roycooper.com/survey/endorse-cooper-260812-email-nd/?source=email_su_pros_jtk1012&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=&ask=5&askdif=25&t=11&akid=2706%2E124072%2EEa81G1)
---
Every signature helps build the people power we need to win a race this big and important. Thanks for being part of this team.

Roy Cooper
| |
* * *
[](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_su_pros_jtk1012&t=2&akid=2706%2E124072%2EEa81G1)
Democrat Roy Cooper is running for U.S. Senate to help take back the Majority for Democrats. North Carolina is Democrats’ best chance to flip a seat from red to blue — the path to stopping Republicans in Washington starts here.

National Republicans will target North Carolina as a key battleground and invest heavily in defeating us.

Cooper is a former state legislator, Attorney General, and most recently Governor of North Carolina. North Carolina will be the most competitive Senate election of 2026, and Cooper enters the race as the most formidable candidate of either party.

Cooper’s signature achievements include helping to expand Medicaid and helping make NC the top state for business by creating thousands of jobs and growing the clean energy economy.

[**_Donate today to help win this seat and flip the Senate blue._**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_su_pros_jtk1012&source=&t=3&akid=2706%2E124072%2EEa81G1)

name: David Hogg
subject: The cost of corporate greed
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY LEADERS WE DESERVE, LEADERSWEDESERVE
body:
We need leaders who are ready to fight for living wages, Medicare for all, and everyday people.
# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20260812-2&t=1&akid=3863%2E587540%2EwNdDTx)
For years, we’ve been told that if you work hard enough, you’ll be able to build a stable life, Peter.
But for millions of working people across this country, that is _far from reality._
[](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260812_2_m4agigs.1Y1uPl&refcode=em20260812-3863&t=2&akid=3863%2E587540%2EwNdDTx)
A new Government Accountability Office report reveals a devastating reality: **more and more workers at some of America’s largest corporations are relying on public assistance like SNAP and Medicaid because their wages simply aren’t enough to cover the cost of living.**
The number of Amazon employees receiving food stamps and Medicaid has **nearly tripled in just five years**. Nearly **12,350** Amazon workers in the states studied were receiving SNAP benefits, and nearly **11,350** were enrolled in Medicaid.
At the same time, gig economy companies like Uber, Lyft, DoorDash, Grubhub, and Instacart are among the top employers of workers receiving these same benefits across multiple states.
While CEOs and shareholders make billions, the people delivering our food, transporting our packages, stocking our shelves, and keeping our economy moving are _struggling_ to afford groceries and health care.
This is exactly what happens when we allow corporations to put profits over people. Our government has been bought off by these major corporations to ensure tax payers pay the price while they refuse to pay their fair share.
Because when workers can’t afford to live on their wages, **everyone pays the price:** Families are forced to choose between rent and medical bills. Workers delay necessary care because they can’t afford it. Parents struggle to provide for their children despite working long hours. And instead of corporations taking responsibility, taxpayers are left filling the gaps.
That’s why electing a new generation of progressive leaders has never been more urgent.
**→ We need** leaders who understand that working people deserve more than survival.
**→ We need** leaders who will fight for a living wage so a full-time job actually provides a path to stability.
**→ We need** leaders who will fight for Medicare for All and a health care system where no one has to worry about going bankrupt because they got sick.
**→ We need** leaders who will stand up to corporations that exploit workers and build an economy where the people who create our prosperity actually share in it.
This moment is about deciding what kind of country we want to build.
Do we accept an economy where some of the wealthiest companies in the world can pay workers so little that they need public assistance? Or do we elect leaders who will fight to make sure every person has the dignity, security, and opportunity they deserve?
That’s why Leaders We Deserve is investing in bold, people-powered candidates who are ready to challenge the status quo and deliver real solutions for working families.
The future we build depends on the leaders we choose today. Together, we can make sure the people are at the center of our politics.
**[If you’re able, will you make a contribution of $5 today to help Leaders We Deserve elect the next generation of progressive leaders who will fight for living wages, affordable health care, and an economy that works for everyone?](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260812_2_m4agigs.1Y1uPl&refcode=em20260812-3863&amount=5&t=3&akid=3863%2E587540%2EwNdDTx)**
**[Donate $5 »](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260812_2_m4agigs.1Y1uPl&amount=5&refcode=em20260812-3863&t=22&akid=3863%2E587540%2EwNdDTx)**
With gratitude,
David Hogg

name: Mark Ronchetti
subject: Bernie denies it. Brazile excuses it. Michigan elected it.
body:
Plus: New Mexico just made the bar exam optional | New episode for dpwillis67@gmail.com

| | | | | |
Bernie Sanders just said he doesn't know a single serious candidate who wants to defund the police, abolish prisons, or open the borders.
EXCEPT....the woman who could be Wisconsin's Democratic nominee for governor by Tuesday night has publicly called for all three. [This is the civil war inside the Democratic Party](https://us.list-manage.com/15GE_04nl7u?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e). Bernie denies it's happening, Donna Brazile says it's no big deal, and Michigan just nominated the guy who proves them both wrong.
Meanwhile, New Mexico just decided that passing the bar exam is optional if you want to practice law here. What could possibly go wrong?!
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/FpXHUquxM2B?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)
| |
🔥 **BERNIE SAYS THESE PEOPLE DON'T EXIST. WE PULLED UP HER POSTS.
** He said it on Pod Save America, and then blamed Fox News for making it sound worse than it is. Francesca Hong's first post is about white supremacy. The second one calls defunding a first step toward abolishing. The third has nothing to do with police, and it's the one you'll be forwarding to people.
---
| [STREAM NOW](https://us.list-manage.com/18vdgh5X6He?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)
---
| |
🚨 **DONNA BRAZILE SAID THIS IS JUST LIKE THE TEA PARTY**
She said it Sunday morning on ABC. Same growing pains Republicans had in 2010, nothing to see here. Scott Jennings was sitting right there and read her the actual list of what these people want to abolish. Police. ICE. Borders. The Senate. The Constitution.
Then he brought up the Democratic attorney general in Michigan who says she can't safely attend her own party's convention. Mark ran in a Tea Party cycle. He has some thoughts about that comparison.

📉 **MEDIA RAN THE 23,000 JOBS NUMBER ALL WEEKEND**
Every broadcast led with it. The economy lost 23,000 jobs in July. Here's what nobody mentioned. Private payrolls went up last month. Government payrolls went down by more than that.
Krysty pulls the whole thing apart, then makes a point that has nothing to do with July. It's about the four years before it. Kevin Hassett went on CNN and explained that part of it was snow. In July.

⚖️ **675 HOURS AND YOU'RE A LAWYER IN NEW MEXICO**
That's it. Twelve months following an attorney around, and you never take the bar. You will also never know which one your lawyer did. Krysty asked whether we're doing this with doctors next.

PLUS: Democratic registration in this state hit a number Vince Torres hasn't seen in his lifetime, Gabe Vasquez put the police union's logo on a mailer you paid for, and the tax secretary who called your paycheck a wealth transfer.

| | | Hi there, it's Martin Sheen. I know seeing my name in your inbox might come as a surprise, but I need to talk to you about the country we both love ‐‐ and why I hope you'll fight for it alongside me.

If you don't have time to hear my whole pitch, here's my ask: [**Will you join me in the fight for our future by donating $7 _(generously matched to $21)_ to help my friends at the DSCC take back the Senate for Democrats?**](https://go.dscc.org/go/23757?amount=7&t=5&firstname=&lastname=&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&addr1=&addr2=&city=Cresco&state=Pennsylvania&zip=18326&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&ask=7&amounts=7%2C14%2C28%2C70&code=DPE-FD-20260812-MartinSheen-WhatASKMeans2026RF-Pros-sl1&refcode=DPE-FD-20260812-MartinSheen-WhatASKMeans2026RF-Pros-sl1&akid=25383%2E9716520%2EYKkKbI)

You see, I was once the "acting" president of the United States ‐‐ and while I may have been playing a fictional role, the lessons I learned were very real.

I'll let you in on the most important one: **Every person has the power to make a difference.**

You might find that hard to believe right now, after everything we've seen and endured in the past year.

I certainly wouldn't blame you for feeling that way.

But look beyond the terrible headlines, and you might just see what I see: Americans of every background and belief, standing up in ways big and small, _sacrificing_ to bring about a future better than our present.

Whether they succeed is, in part, up to you.

One seemingly small action you can take to help is to join with your fellow Democrats and pitch in $7 to help elect a Democratic Senate majority.

Flipping the Senate and bringing accountability to this administration _will_ make a difference, but it will only be possible if we lock hands, raise our voices, and come together ‐‐ that's when we can accomplish truly incredible things.

**The headwinds we face are strong, but we are stronger. Donald Trump is determined, but we are more determined. And right now, as we stretch our arms toward the future, I hope you'll join me.**

TO: U.S. Postal Service
FROM: Willis
Subject: Please don’t cave to Trump.

Dear USPS,

**I am writing today to DEMAND that you stand up to Donald Trump and PROTECT vote-by-mail.**

Vote-by-mail has expanded voting access to millions of Americans in rural areas, serving overseas, and in marginalized communities.

Limiting access to states who do Trump’s bidding is UNDEMOCRATIC and straight up AUTHORITARIAN!

The Postal Service is a vital institution that has done so much good for our country — **so please don’t sacrifice everything you stand for now.**

[I’m signing this letter today to DEMAND you stand up to Trump and this disgusting attack on voting rights. Along with my signature, I’m chipping in $3 to the Voter Protection Project to ensure we flip the House this November and SAVE vote-by-mail »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/123760?t=9&akid=27546%2E878179%2Ei0I1Ss) | [SIGN THE LETTER ASAP: DEMAND USPS PROTECT MAIL-IN VOTING »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/123760?t=10&akid=27546%2E878179%2Ei0I1Ss)

**_X Willis_**
We can’t let Trump get away with this!
_The Voter Protection Project_

subject: Sorry about Karoline Leavitt
body:
[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/126?t=1001&akid=8278%2E582294%2EvttYnw ]Chris Pappas for Senate[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/126?t=1002&akid=8278%2E582294%2EvttYnw ]Chris Pappas for Senate

I’m sorry about Karoline
Leavitt.

Before she was hand-picked as Donald Trump’s White House Press Secretary,
Karoline ran against me for Congress here in New Hampshire. She lost — by
nearly 10 points.

[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260812_3.953coN&refcode=em20260812-8278&amount=5&t=1003&akid=8278%2E582294%2EvttYnw ][IMG]

But that campaign gave her exactly what she needed: a test run for the
MAGA talking points she now repeats from behind the White House podium.
She’s been practicing the spin for years — and while New Hampshire wasn’t
buying it, Trump was.

Let me be clear: I don’t regret a thing about standing up to Karoline and
her MAGA agenda — not then and not now.

This race is going to be tough. National Republicans and John Sununu are
doing everything they can to flip this seat. They’re recycling the same
extremist ideas, running the same playbook and relying on people like
Karoline Leavitt to carry their message.

We beat her once and with your help, we’ll do it again.

[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260812_3.953coN&refcode=em20260812-8278&amount=5&t=1004&akid=8278%2E582294%2EvttYnw ]Will
you chip in $5 today to help us keep this Senate seat blue
and fight for what matters to Granite Staters?

[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260812_3.953coN&amount=5&refcode=em20260812-8278&t=1023&akid=8278%2E582294%2EvttYnw ]Donate $5 »

Thanks for being in this fight with me.

Chris Pappas

body:
THANK YOU to everyone who voted for me. Let me tell you about our big win and invite you to what's next!

| | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/058382db2101/seattles-biggest-teslamusk-protest-yet-63314?e=10cc7d1928)

| |
Peter — I just lost the election for US Congress. But I feel like we won. **Let me tell you why. (Video:**[**Facebook**](https://us.list-manage.com/liZr74Jgel0?e=10cc7d1928&c2id=f043392f3ce30349559f8b57e57124ab)**,**[**Instagram**](https://us.list-manage.com/XPb8izsVKqg?e=10cc7d1928&c2id=f043392f3ce30349559f8b57e57124ab)**,**[**YouTube**](https://us.list-manage.com/14M0Y2bXl5m?e=10cc7d1928&c2id=f043392f3ce30349559f8b57e57124ab)**)**.
First off, thank you to everyone who trusted me with your vote. We'll finish with about 11% of the total ballots cast and over 22k votes while maintaining our pledge not to accept any outside funding.
**This election is over but I'm not going anywhere.** Neither is my team.
It was a remarkable honor to travel the district and meet with voters and hear your stories. To spend hours on the phone discussing your thoughtful questions and dreams for the district.
**This is the beautiful part of politics and it's left me feeling more hopeful than ever.**
Our team is already back at work because our campaign was never about me and we have bigger goals than a seat in Congress. We have fascists to defeat and a country to free from the suffocating grip of billionaires. This is the fight of our lives.
**We've got to keep it rolling. My homepage lists several great orgs,** including ones I'm involved with to get money out of politics, win the midterms, and prepare for a general strike.
Whether you join me and my team, one of these other groups, or another you're familiar with, I hope you'll stay connected and involved. If we continue to build our community, **we will be unstoppable.**

**Please Watch & Share the New Video**
[Instagram](https://us.list-manage.com/qwrnkAUMx28?e=10cc7d1928&c2id=f043392f3ce30349559f8b57e57124ab)[Facebook](https://us.list-manage.com/13UD59ujJW8?e=10cc7d1928&c2id=f043392f3ce30349559f8b57e57124ab)[YouTube](https://us.list-manage.com/ROEk_HWUa4i?e=10cc7d1928&c2id=f043392f3ce30349559f8b57e57124ab)
We're going to continue to AIM HIGHER. See you out there! — Devin & Team

## Trump Declares Tight Grip on Strait of Hormuz
President Trump posted on Wednesday that the United States has "total control" of the Strait of Hormuz, writing, _"I THINK WE WILL KEEP IT,"_ while Iranian officials shot back that the strait "remains blocked" until its conditions are met. [See the President's post here](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0L1u7CAUBOCngW5Xhx8DLiiudOVuU0VKaRH7sCaLjQVnvcrbR84rpJ2RPmnm4zbeQsppu7-FFT3FMm74ahmJsI5Un-v-QNzTdm9UQ6IcHlibGCVIcwF3EWoME6UDRx347COiRMXRC-uMEZ3ue774z0lDFE7H3slO9ZOYbeckzAZRWegVT_70wAklAHRnrhGlAKdk7ILRNiqmAedEpV6_StpowZi_y4H1OpWVZ78Q7Y2pf0wOTA5Un7S0MqWQz_4MNVQM-X_ZQp7fz1FMDntp1JgchLDgFAhrHEglTG959fP-SjmnZizTcF9D-qU4_fGhw8ufAAAA___ESHg8). Peter, I’m not sending this message to everyone.

I’m specifically reaching out to you because, as my team and I were going through our supporter records, your file stood apart.
You’re one of my best-informed grassroots supporters. You’ve been getting these emails for a while now, and we see you're keeping up with the latest from our campaign. Thank you.
**I am so grateful for your time and attention, and today, I’m asking you to take the next step. Here’s why:**
Our mid-month deadline is two days away, and we’re falling short of our $1 million goal. Unlike my Trump-backed MAGA opponent, I’m not a Washington DC insider relying on my billionaire connections to buy my way to victory. I’m depending on people like you – who believe in building a better future for our country and give what they can to help out when it matters most.
_Right now is one of those moments._
With President Trump personally attacking me and GOP super PACs pouring just shy of $100 million into North Carolina so far to defeat me, the polls are tightening. **If we don’t have the resources to fight back and surge ahead, we’ll put our chances of flipping this seat in jeopardy.**
[**_That’s why I’m asking, Peter: Will you chip in your first $5 donation to help us reach our mid-month goal, win in North Carolina and take back the Senate for Democrats?_**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/14264?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1114&amount=5&t=8&akid=2670%2E124072%2EDzxCU_)

Roy
